cashsum.note: Cash = bank accounts. Transfers between your own bank accounts net to zero and are not shown.

acctsum.note: Bank accounts show money in / out; credit cards show spend / repayments and the closing amount owing.

checks.title: Identical bank statement lines
checks.why: Same account, date, amount and description more than once - a statement imported twice or a genuine repeat that needs confirming.

checks.title: Duplicate payments
checks.why: The same contact paid or received the same amount on the same day more than once.

checks.title: Possible duplicate invoices / bills
checks.why: Same customer/supplier and total within 7 days on two different documents.

checks.title: Bank lines unreconciled for over 30 days
checks.why: Old statement lines that have not been matched or coded leave the books out of step with the bank.

checks.title: Large round-sum spend money
checks.why: Spend of $1,000+ in exact $500 multiples coded straight to an expense (no bill) - worth confirming there is an invoice behind it.

checks.title: Unusually large expense postings
checks.why: More than three standard deviations above that account's usual posting (accounts with 6+ postings).

checks.title: Suspense account activity (balance -189.90)
checks.why: Uncoded items are parked in Suspense; a non-zero balance means transactions still need a proper account.

checks.title: Payments not fully allocated
checks.why: Overpayments / prepayments held as credit; apply them to documents so the aged reports are clean.

checks.title: Bank accounts overdrawn
checks.why: A negative ledger balance on a bank account usually means a missing deposit or a mis-coded transfer.
